items.reason: A gentle cleanser with no actives that cleans without adding to the dry, flaky look.
A simple hydrating serum to help dry-looking skin feel more comfortable, with the scan showing low moisture.
A rich ceramide cream to cushion the skin barrier and soften the look of flaking.
A tinted mineral SPF 50 for daily sun protection, with iron oxides that blend well on deeper skin tones.

response.routine_note: I removed the glycolic toner and the vitamin C serum because exfoliating and strongly acidic leave-on products are too harsh for skin while you are taking isotretinoin, so please ask your prescriber or a dermatologist about the flakiness and when to add actives. Cleanse gently morning and night, apply the hydrating serum then the cream, and finish with sunscreen in the morning.
